devui-runtime: p=$(pidof zte_topsw_devui); echo PID:$p; for n in status maps; do cat /proc/$p/$n; done; ls -l /proc/$p/fd; readlink /proc/$p/exe; readlink /proc/$p/cwd; cat /etc/init.d/zte_topsw_devui; cat /etc/init.d/zte_topsw_daemon
drm-state: ls -la /sys/class/drm /sys/kernel/debug/dri /sys/kernel/debug/dri/0 /sys/class/backlight 2>/dev/null; for p in /sys/class/drm/card0-*; do [ -d "$p" ] || continue; echo "$p"; for n in status enabled modes; do [ ! -r "$p/$n" ] || { echo "$n"; cat "$p/$n"; }; done; done; cat [REDACTED_ENCODED_OR_IDENTIFIER] [REDACTED_ENCODED_OR_IDENTIFIER] [REDACTED_ENCODED_OR_IDENTIFIER] 2>/dev/null
ufi-layout: ls -la /data/ufi-tools /data/plugins /data/zwrt-datad /usr/share /usr/zte_web 2>/dev/null; find /data/ufi-tools -maxdepth 3 -type f -name '*plugin*'; find /data/plugins -maxdepth 3 -type f; ls -l /usr/lib/*lv* /usr/lib/*drm* /usr/lib/*devui* /usr/lib/*zte* /lib/*musl* /lib/*ld-* 2>/dev/null
